title: Black Forest Labs Opens 5.6B Parameter Image Model for Consumer GPUs
summary:
Native 4K output and bounding-box layout control are the primary features of a newly released open-weights image generator. Developed by Black Forest Labs, FLUX 3 Image Klein uses 5.6B parameters to operate on a single consumer GPU and enables multi-reference generation using up to 10 images per prompt. The tool is available in both base and distilled 16 step variants to optimize for speed.

The model is distributed through Hugging Face and is compatible with diffusers, ComfyUI, and Spaces. Integration partners SGLang and Ostris AI Toolkit provided day 0 support, while vLLM-Omni collaborated with NVIDIA to optimize the model via BF16, FP8, and NVFP4 checkpoint formats and custom kernels for the transformer and text encoder.

selectedTweets.text:
🎉 Day-0 support for FLUX 3 Image Klein is here in vLLM-Omni!

We worked with Black Forest Labs and NVIDIA to bring the new image-model release to the vLLM-Omni serving stack.

What the integration brings:
🎨 FLUX 3 Image Klein image generation
⚡ BF16, FP8 and NVFP4 checkpoint formats
🛠️ Custom kernels, with optimizations across the transformer and text encoder
📦 Hugging Face model-path handling for the text encoder and autoencoder

Thanks to Black Forest Labs, NVIDIA and the vLLM-Omni community for the collaboration.

Docker image:
docker pull vllm/vllm-omni:flux-3-image-klein
